name: deepseek-ai/deepep
title: DeepSeek ships DeepEP V2.6 and DeepEP-Ascend V1.1, plus fused Ascend kernels in FlashMLA
summary: DeepEP V2.6 adds buffer resizing, FP32 combine output and redundant-expert mapping; DeepEP-Ascend V1.1 drops the HCCL runtime dependency and adds cluster-scale training pieces; FlashMLA gains fused kernels and head128 support for Huawei Ascend. Open MoE serving and training code now targets Ascend 950 as well as NVIDIA SM100.
